register.labelZh: LIGHT AND LIGHTEN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: LIGHT AND LIGHTEN Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: light on 和 light upon 可以表示偶然發現、注意到或想到某事物。；light up 可以描述螢幕、招牌和燈亮起來,也可以表示燈光把房間、道路或天空照亮。；lighten up 適合用來請某人放鬆、減少擔心或享受當下的情況。
register.summaryEn: Light on and light upon help you describe finding, noticing or thinking of something unexpectedly. Light up can describe screens, signs and lamps becoming bright, or lights making a room, road or sky bright. Lighten up is useful when asking someone to relax, worry less or enjoy the situation.
contextsZh: 描述意外的發現和構思
contextsEn: Talk clearly about light and brightness

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；light on 和 light upon 在本練習中意思相同。；light up 可以表示某物亮起來,也可以表示某物把另一處照亮:螢幕亮了起來。燈光照亮了房間。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Light on and light upon have the same meaning in this exercise. Light up can describe something becoming bright or something making another place bright: The screen lit up. The lamps lit up the room.
